code:
SELECT StageName,
  COUNT(*) AS Cnt
FROM Opportunity
GROUP BY StageName
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10
caption: Illustrative. In T-SQL, TOP replaces LIMIT.

code:
SELECT StageName, COUNT(Id) Cnt
FROM Opportunity
GROUP BY StageName
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 10
caption: Illustrative. Same logic, different target.
